::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use the rolling-update route for a standard three-month update, or the one-off
route for a completed bespoke report.

## Before you start

- Choose the correct report route.
- For a rolling update, identify both approved source data releases.
- For a one-off report, complete the analysis, PDF and disclosure review first.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Choose one route → prepare and review the report → publish the approved product
→ render and deploy the website.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Choose the report route and confirm responsibility** — rolling update from standard approved releases, or one-off publication of a completed bespoke report | Use [Rolling three-month update](../../operations/post-redcap/rolling-update.qmd) or [One-off CVD report](../../operations/post-redcap/one-off-report.qmd). |
| 2 | [Public Methods]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--methods} | **Preserve the approved statistical meaning** — definitions; interpretation; limitations; public wording | Use the relevant part of the [Public Methods Manual](../../methods/index.qmd) while reviewing the report. |
| 3A | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Build and review a rolling update, when that is the chosen route** — report month; two approved sources; version; generated page; frozen source copies | Follow [Build a rolling three-month CVD update](../workflows/reporting/rolling-update.qmd). |
| 4B | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Prepare, approve and publish a one-off report, when that is the chosen route** — completed PDF; landing page; report record; exact approved package | Follow [Prepare, approve and publish a one-off CVD report](../workflows/reporting/one-off-report.qmd). |
| 4 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Render and deploy the published report page** — automatic report listing; Git review; pull request; live-site check | Follow [Edit and publish website content](edit-publish-website-content.qmd). Quarto discovers the published landing page during the normal render; no separate listing-refresh action is required. |

## How to confirm completion

The selected report route finishes successfully, the website deployment
succeeds, and the report page, download and listing are correct on the live site.
